description: Source file containing utility functions for testing and manipulating disk cache entries, including creating corrupt files, removing or corrupting SHA256 hashes, and corrupting stream length in cache entries.

methods.name: CreateCorruptFileForTests
methods.description: Creates a dummy file at the specified cache path with a given key for testing purposes.

methods.name: RemoveKeySHA256FromEntry
methods.description: Removes the SHA256 hash from a cache entry file, effectively invalidating the key's SHA256.

methods.name: CorruptKeySHA256FromEntry
methods.description: Overwrites the SHA256 hash in a cache entry with corrupt data.

methods.name: CorruptStream0LengthFromEntry
methods.description: Modifies the stream size in a cache entry to an invalid large value to simulate corruption.
